title: Big-Foot de Thalek Hi Sparkling B

parts: Big-Foot de Thalek Hi Sparkling B
Male born on December 10, 2004. HD: Clear. Shoulder height: 63 cm.
WORLD CHAMPION 2005 IN PUPPY CLASS: WORLD HOPE 2005
From the cross of our spectacular stud dog Zottels Happily Ever After with our female Wanda, combining the most important European bloodlines in his pedigree.
He now lives with our friends Patricia Hazán and Dante Olla of Sparkling Bear's kennel in Buenos Aires (Argentina). We thank them for their trust in our kennel, our dogs and our breeding approach.
His show career has already begun. We hope and wish that his career will be as successful as his father's.
He has already sired several litters and has offspring in various parts of the world: China, Ecuador, Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Spain...
